parts.t: Classic Vancouver Special in the heart of Dunbar with a SUITE! Live in one of the most sought-after locations in Vancouver close to transit & walking seconds to cafes, shops and everything Dunbar has to offer. Steps to Schools, Library and Dunbar Community Centre. Featuring 5 bedrooms, 4 baths, separate laundry, separate entrance, sundeck railing & cover, stairs at the rear & a double garage. Double glazed windows up & down. 2 blocks to St.George private school, easy access to UBC!
